Interface RmiPlayerSession

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
public interface RmiPlayerSession extends Remote
Per-player remote session returned by the RMI lobby after registration.

The client invokes game operations directly on this stub. The server-side implementation owns the nickname associated with the session, so action identity is not taken from client-provided payloads.
